notes: v4.16: fixed silver bills being auto-detected as Gold-Diamond. The old detector counted loose words and fired on the user's own "AURUM DIAMONDS" shop name (dia/diamond) plus 14K fragments from a neighbouring sheet in the photo. Detection now vetoes gold when the bill carries silver evidence (Silver column / silver rate line), requires strong gold evidence (diamond/stone weight-or-rate columns, JDM-style item codes, or the JDM customer name), and no longer counts dia/diamond as gold hints. A standalone Gold column also counts as gold evidence, so plain gold bills (no diamonds, e.g. Bill 22) detect as gold. Also fixed fresh-laptop Setup: it now refuses Python 3.14+ (which cannot resolve the reading-engine packages) and installs/uses Python 3.12 instead, with a one-package-at-a-time pip retry if the combined install fails. v4.15: Automatic format detection for Gold-Diamond estimates (JDM format) and Silver Parchis; fixed Gold table parsing with complete 46-row extraction, lowered Row 1 cutoff threshold, 0.2 degree projection tilt search, and closest-anchor alignment to eliminate row drift. v4.14: separate multipliers in top bar for Making x/g (default 4) and Making x/pc (default 4); Making Charge now displays in its natural unit (/gm or /pc) and calculates customer sell price accordingly; editable Rs/piece column to easily convert any row between piece-rate (/pc) and gram-rate (/gm); scrollable header with mouse-wheel navigation and direct 1:1 click-and-drag scrolling. v4.13: new Rs/piece column (supplier's per-piece rate, e.g. CASTING KADA 55, COIN ARTS 1800); Total Rs/g renamed Supplier Charge and now shows the charge in its natural unit — 55/pp for piece-rate items, 0.30/gm for per-gram items; Making Charge is now rate x mult in the same unit (55x4 = 220 per piece for CASTING KADA). No math changes: MRP / Sell Price identical. v4.12: the reader no longer lets a labour rate land in T+W — when the position-based row search fails (tilted/cropped photo), it now retries on values alone keeping left-to-right order, and the position-based fallback rejects T+W outside 20–200 and skips labour tokens, so a swapped row comes out flagged/incomplete instead of confidently wrong. v4.11: Save Sale now auto-deducts the sold grams from the row's net wt (silver wt, totals and MRP all follow at once); selling more than the net wt left is refused on Save (Calculate only warns); a rapid re-save of the same grams is refused so a double-click can't deduct twice. Deleting a saved sale does not add grams back. v4.10: the frozen header moves with the body on horizontal scrolling even when the mouse is over the header strip. v4.9: Making Charge/g is Making x Total Rs/g (wastage Rs/g + labour Rs/g); the Tunch cell shows the computed purity (a typed tunch still wins and still follows a wastage override). Sell Price is the true MRP: metal = net weight x purity (tunch) / 100 x pure rate, plus customer making per gram x net weight, plus 3% GST. Cost side unchanged (silver weight by T+W, Total Amt). Update-channel build uses the compact recognizer (small detector + tiny reader): same accuracy on clean photos; very poor photos may read slightly worse than the full build. Everything from v4.7 included: fixed column shift, frozen header, PP-OCRv6 engine, rescue pass, loading bar, sell calculator, Save Sale per login with duplicates refused.
